prompt: Fix audit so an artifact is accepted only when its generated ID set exactly equals the independent reference ID set. Preserve the public interface, reject a same-count substitution, fail closed when the reference count disagrees with expected_count, and verify the result with the existing test command.
expected_behavior: audit reports missing and unexpected IDs, stores distinct deterministic set fingerprints, rejects same-count substitutions and reference-count mismatches, and accepts an exact match.
failure_conditions: missing or unexpected IDs are not reported
tests do not detect the original count-only implementation

evaluation.use: 個別契約の回帰資料。skillの採否には使用しない
